message.content:
**"Buenos días, equipo."**

A quick note: in Spanish, "good morning" is literally *buenos días* ("good days") — it's always plural. If you want a slightly warmer alternative for a group, you could also say *"Buenos días a todos"* ("Good morning, everyone").
